errorRules.message: SiliconFlow rejected the request as unauthorized (HTTP 401; an unauthenticated GET https://api.siliconflow.com/v1/models returned code 30014 with the message "Token is invalid."). Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Get one at {setupUrl}

SiliconFlow reports insufficient permissions (HTTP 403). Its error-handling page (https://docs.siliconflow.com/en/faqs/error-code) says: "The most common reason is that the model requires real-name authentication."

SiliconFlow rate limit reached (HTTP 429). Its error-handling page (https://docs.siliconflow.com/en/faqs/error-code) says to refer to the error message to determine whether the limit is RPM / RPD / TPM / TPD / IPM / IPD.

SiliconFlow model '{model}' was not found. Its error-handling page (https://docs.siliconflow.com/en/faqs/error-code) shows the HTTP 400 message "Model does not exist. Please check it carefully." with code 20012.

instructions: 1. Visit: https://cloud.siliconflow.com/ and create a SiliconFlow account (https://docs.siliconflow.com/en/userguide/quickstart)
2. Open the API Keys page at https://cloud.siliconflow.com/account/ak, click Create API Key and copy the key (https://docs.siliconflow.com/en/userguide/quickstart)
3. Billing as the vendor words it on https://www.siliconflow.com/pricing: "Flexible token pricing, high usage limits, and postpaid billing—plus $1 in free credits to get you started!"
setup.description: Endpoint https://api.siliconflow.com/v1 (the chat-completions API reference lists the server https://api.siliconflow.com/v1 and POST /chat/completions with bearer auth; the Text Generation page says "You can make end-to-end API requests using the OpenAI SDK" and the Quick Start says "The platform currently supports most OpenAI-related parameters."). This entry is docs-verified only: an unauthenticated GET of https://api.siliconflow.com/v1/models answered HTTP 401 without a key, so the model ids come from the vendor's public docs and the roster has not been checked; it is not yet live-verified. That GET returned code 30014 with the message "Token is invalid." (2026-09-29), so errorRules match status 401 and the statuses and messages on the vendor's error-handling page (https://docs.siliconflow.com/en/faqs/error-code). capabilities.structuredOutput is false because the model pages show Structured Outputs "Not supported" on the 12 catalog models; the JSON Mode page documents response_format={"type": "json_object"} and this entry sets no responseFormatDowngrade quirk. vision is true for moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6, moonshotai/Kimi-K2.5, Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B, Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and google/gemma-4-31B-it from the model page value Support image input "Supported"; image input was not exercised. models.defaultContextWindow (32768) and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens (4096) are placeholders for ids outside the catalog that the vendor does not publish; the status values are ones the schema requires (production), not vendor statements. billingPolicy free-tier follows the pricing page's "$1 in free credits" statement.

authProbe.method: unauthenticated GET https://api.siliconflow.com/v1/models — body {"code":30014,"data":null,"message":"Token is invalid."} with header www-authenticate: Bearer realm="siliconflow", error="invalid_token", error_description="Token is invalid."; credential-free, no key used
